title: Automatic Model Card Generation Using an LLM
abstract: arXiv:2608.24807v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model cards are structured documents that summarize key information about machine learning models to improve transparency, usability, and accountability. However, they often lack a consistent structure, and many models provide no model cards, making comparison and interpretation difficult. This paper presents two contributions. First, we propose MCTidy, an LLM-based approach that reorganizes existing model cards into a standardized template to improve clarity and comparability. Second, we introduce MCGenie, an LLM-based system that generates model cards directly from model repository data. We apply MCTidy to 48 Hugging Face model cards and evaluate information retention, section alignment, hallucination, and stability. Our findings show high information retention with minimal textual loss, accurate section assignment, rare hallucinations primarily in descriptive sections, and strong stability across runs. translated_title: 使用大语言模型自动生成模型卡片
translated_abstract: 模型卡片是结构化文档，用于总结机器学习模型的关键信息，以提高透明度、可用性和问责性。然而，它们往往缺乏一致的结构，且许多模型没有提供模型卡片，这使得比较和解读变得困难。本文提出了两项贡献。首先，我们提出了MCTidy，一种基于大语言模型的方法，将现有模型卡片重新组织为标准模板，以提高清晰度和可比性。其次，我们介绍了MCGenie，一个基于大语言模型的系统，直接从模型仓库数据生成模型卡片。我们将MCTidy应用于48个Hugging Face模型卡片，并评估了信息保留、章节对齐、幻觉和稳定性。我们的发现显示，信息保留率高且文本损失极小，章节分配准确，幻觉主要出现在描述性章节中且罕见，并且跨运行稳定性强。我们通过生成来评估MCGenie。
tldr: 本文提出两种基于大语言模型的方法——MCTidy和MCGenie，分别用于标准化现有模型卡片和直接从模型仓库生成模型卡片，以提高模型卡片的清晰度、可比性和自动化程度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two LLM-based methods, MCTidy and MCGenie, to standardize existing model cards and generate model cards directly from model repositories, enhancing clarity, comparability, and automation.
